title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security to 'Enabled'
reason: Previous versions of Windows stored secrets in the Local Security Authority (LSA). With Windows Defender Credential Guard enabled, the LSA process in the operating system talks to a new component called the isolated LSA process that stores and protects those secrets using virtualization-based security.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Select Platform Security Level' is set to 'Secure Boot' or higher
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Select Platform Security Level to 'Secure Boot' or 'Secure Boot and DMA Protection'
reason: Secure Boot can help reduce the risk of bootloader attacks and in conjunction with DMA protections to help protect data from being scraped from memory.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Virtualization Based Protection of Code Integrity' is set to 'Enabled with UEFI lock'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Virtualization Based Protection of Code Integrity to 'Enabled with UEFI lock'
reason: The Enabled with UEFI lock option ensures that Virtualization Based Protection of Code Integrity cannot be disabled remotely.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Require UEFI Memory Attributes Table' is set to 'True (checked)'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Require UEFI Memory Attributes Table to 'True (checked)'
reason: This setting will help protect this control from being enabled on a system that is not compatible which could lead to a crash or data loss.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Credential Guard Configuration' is set to 'Enabled with UEFI lock' (MS Only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Credential Guard Configuration to 'Enabled with UEFI lock'
reason: The Enabled with UEFI lock option ensures that Credential Guard cannot be disabled remotely.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Credential Guard Configuration' is set to 'Disabled' (DC Only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Credential Guard Configuration to 'Disabled'
reason: Credential Guard is not useful on Domain Controllers and can cause crashes on them.

title: Ensure 'Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Secure Launch Configuration' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Device Guard\Turn On Virtualization Based Security: Secure Launch Configuration to 'Enabled'
reason: Secure Launch uses Intel Trusted Execution Technology (TXT) and Runtime BIOS Resilience features to prevent firmware exploits from being able to impact the security of the Windows Virtualization Based Security environment.
